title: Report a network interface name
prompt:
The board is already reachable over SSH (MOSS_DEVICE_*).

List interface names under /sys/class/net (device_network is fine if you also confirm the name exists there). Record evidence metric `net_iface` whose observed value is exactly one interface name, the first directory entry of /sys/class/net.

Do not change addresses, routes, links, firewall rules, or ssh. Do not reboot or reflash.

evidence.probe: shopt -s nullglob; ifaces=(/sys/class/net/*); if [ "${#ifaces[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then exit 1; fi; basename "${ifaces[0]}"
